title: Apam balik
hookLine: Malaysian-inspired apam balik with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Apam balik
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix milk, oil and egg together. Sift flour, baking powder and salt into the mixture. Stir well until all ingredients are combined evenly. Incorporate {m53049_1}, {m53049_2}, {m53049_3}, and {m53049_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Apam balik
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread some batter onto the pan. Spread a thin layer of batter to the side of the pan. Cover the pan for 30-60 seconds until small air bubbles appear. Incorporate {m53049_5}, {m53049_6}, {m53049_7}, {m53049_8}, and {m53049_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Apam balik
steps.instructionTemplate: Add butter, cream corn, crushed peanuts and sugar onto the pancake. Fold the pancake into half once the bottom surface is browned.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Apam balik
steps.instructionTemplate: Cut into wedges and best eaten when it is warm. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.
